audit_title: Phase 8 Baseline Audit and Independent-Test Divergence Investigation
safety_designation: RESEARCH DEMONSTRATION PROTOTYPE — NOT FOR LIFE SAFETY

divergence_investigation_roc_auc_vs_even.paradox_statement: Independent-test window ROC-AUC is 94.71%, yet Event Recall is 14.81% and Event Precision is 6.67%.

mechanisms_identified.factor: Extreme Class Imbalance Masking in ROC-AUC
mechanisms_identified.explanation: The 230 test files produced 2,111 evaluation windows, of which only 46 were positive (2.18%). Because the model assigned near-zero probabilities to the vast majority of negative windows (e.g., church bells, wind, machinery), the False Positive Rate (FPR) remained low, inflating ROC-AUC to 94.71%. In contrast, the Precision-Recall AUC (PR-AUC), which is sensitive to true precision under heavy imbalance, was only 23.37%.

mechanisms_identified.factor: The Multi-Window Confirmation Bottleneck on Short Clips
mechanisms_identified.explanation: Nineteen (19) out of 27 gunshot evaluation recordings (Mitchell Roberts ballistic range files) were trimmed to 0.50s - 0.57s. Sliced with a 0.96s window and 0.48s hop, a ~0.50s clip produces only a single analysis window. Because the Phase 7 recommended configuration strictly mandated confirm_windows = 2 (two consecutive windows >= 0.75), isolated 0.50s clips could mathematically NEVER trigger an event alert, regardless of how high their single-window scores were.

mechanisms_identified.factor: Window Recall (50.0%) vs Event Recall (14.8%) Decoupling
mechanisms_identified.explanation: Window recall was 50.0% (23 out of 46 gunshot windows had score >= 0.75). However, 14 of those 23 positive windows were isolated single windows from Mitchell Roberts range clips. Because they lacked a second consecutive confirmation window, all 14 shots were dropped during temporal aggregation, collapsing event recall to only 4 detected events (14.81%).

mechanisms_identified.factor: Event Precision Collapse from Acoustic Near-Twins
mechanisms_identified.explanation: Because event recall was artificially choked to only 4 true positives, the 56 false alerts generated across the 200 difficult acoustic mimics (predominantly pyrotechnic aerial bursts and close thunderclaps) dominated the denominator: Precision = 4 / (4 + 56) = 6.67%.

divergence_investigation_roc_auc_vs_even.conclusion: The high ROC-AUC is mathematically genuine for window discrimination, but the low Event Recall and Precision were caused by an acoustic duration mismatch (two-window confirmation applied to 0.5s clips) combined with uncalibrated pyrotechnic/thunder false alerts. Fixing short-event confirmation and pyrotechnic discrimination is the central engineering task of Phase 8.
